justification: Evidence-backed categorical gate. WOCAT 507 describes restoring degraded wasteland and improving depleted farmland (Kenya example, PDF p1). Within the regeneration-on-farmland family, WorldCover alone cannot identify degradation or farmland history. Positive classes require observed depleted/degraded farmland masks; bare soil alone is never evidence of restoration potential. This gate establishes land-use compatibility, not regeneration success or rootstock presence. Tree cover remains unresolved.
